learning_outcomes.text: This course aims to provide insight into both analog and digital communication.
The student can explain the different modulation techniques and their applications.
The student can build and test an analog communication system.

syllabus_topics: Amplitude modulation: - AM analysis; - single sideband modulation
Frequency modulation: - angle modulation; - FM modulation; - PM modulation; - stereo FM
Digital communication: - Pulse-code modulation; - Delta and pulse modulation; - digital modulation techniques; - spread spectrum techniques
assessment_rules: The assessment is a 100% oral exam with written preparation during the first exam period (June). For the second exam chance (August), it is also a 100% oral exam with written preparation. There are no partial transfers for this course.
bibliography: modern electronic communication, Jeffrey S. Beasly & G. Miller ISBN 0-13-129302-8
